name: Eugen Soloviov
headline: Software engineer and quant developer: web, trading systems, blockchain, AI
summary: Software engineer with 20+ years of shipping. Long before the AI boom I built websites and products end to end: design, architecture, frontend, backend and DevOps, including six years running my own web studio. Quant developer and researcher: trading since 2011, building trading robots, strategies, backtests, research and analytics since 2017. In blockchain I built an ICO analytics platform and my own DEX from scratch, and launched a chain on Cosmos SDK. I have also made a few games, edited video and worked with electronics. With AI, all of these skills only got stronger.
